rule: Always held. Spare slots from the other sleeves fall back here.

holds: US, Europe, UK, Japan, Emerging, Asia Pacific ETFs
rule: Top 2 regions by risk-adjusted momentum, only while above their 200-day average.
Top 3 by risk-adjusted momentum and in an uptrend, 5% each. Kept until they fall out of the top 8.
15% out of equities when both warning signs are on: All-World below its 200-day average and down over 3 months.

holds: 160 global large, mid and small caps
rule: Top 12 by a blend of 12-month and 6-month risk-adjusted momentum, closeness to the 52-week high and low volatility. New picks must be above their 200-day average. Sized by inverse volatility, 4–15% each, at most 35% per sector. A holding stays while it ranks in the top 40.
When fewer than 12 stocks qualify, the empty slots stay in cash. In a broad sell-off few stocks hold their uptrend, so pie B de-risks by itself.
